title: How Do I: Use the Word Add-in for Business Central Report Layouts
summary: The Dynamics 365 Business Central Word add-in is a free Microsoft Word extension that simplifies designing Word layouts for document reports by enabling easy field insertion, layout comments, and conditional content hiding based on data values. The add-in requires Business Central version 25 or later, with full data picker functionality in version 27 and later.
key_points: The Word add-in provides a task pane for inserting data fields, labels, and report information into layouts without manual workarounds
Multiple hide controls automatically remove content when empty: Hide Field if Zero, Hide Empty Table, Hide Empty Table Row, and Hide Empty Table Column
Layout comments can be embedded directly in Word files to document design decisions without affecting printed output
The add-in works only with data already in the report; adding new fields or complex conditional logic requires developer involvement
Word layouts still lack advanced features found in RDLC layouts such as conditional formatting, calculated aggregations, and complex page controls

quotes.text: The add-in has grown steadily since then, and this post covers what it can do today and how to use it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that the Word add-in is an evolving feature with recent improvements worth understanding

quotes.text: Controlling what appears and what stays hidden depending on the data in the document required either manual workarounds or developer involvement.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the problem the add-in solves, making document design more accessible without developer help

quotes.text: Word layouts are genuinely easier to work with for straightforward document design, and the add-in has made real progress.
